# Community Core Stack — City 02 source

Motor City can automatically download and prepare the public **Community Core Stack — City 02** Unity environment by **lucspinto / lucrybpin**.

Source repository: https://github.com/lucrybpin/unity-community-core-city-02

The source project states that the environment is built from Kenney assets and is released under **CC0 — No Rights Reserved**. The imported third-party files are generated locally by the Unity Editor installer and are not authored by G3R Studio.

This file documents the current external asset source used by the project.
